module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

    assign p1y = p1a & p1b & p1c & p1d;
    assign p2y = p2a & p2b & p2c & p2d;

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!resetn) begin
      q <= 16'b0;
    end else begin
      if (byteena[0]) begin
        q <= d;
      end else if (byteena[1]) begin
        q <= {q[15:8], d[7:0]};
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input [7:0] d,
  input areset,
  output reg [7:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
      q <= 8'b0;
    end else begin
      q <= d;
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

  reg [6:0] stack;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enable) begin
      stack <= {S, stack[6:1]}; // Shift right, new bit in MSB
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    if (enable) begin
      Z = stack[6]; // Output the new bit when enabled
    end else begin
      // Normal operation: output based on control signals
      Z = A ? B : (B ? C : stack[5]);
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] in,
  output out_and,
  output out_or,
  output out_xor
);

  assign out_and = ∈    // AND of all input bits
  assign out_or  = |in;    // OR of all input bits
  assign out_xor = ^in;    // XOR of all input bits

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input x,
  input y,
  output z
);

  wire c, d, e, f, g, h;

  assign c = ~x;          // NOT of x
  assign d = ~y;          // NOT of y
  assign e = c & d;       // AND of c and d
  assign f = e | x;       // OR of e and x
  assign g = f ^ y;       // XOR of f and y
  assign h = ~g;          // NOT of g
  assign z = h;           // z is h

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input load,
  input ena,
  input [3:0] data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
      q <= 4'b0000;
    end else begin
      if (load) begin
        q <= data;
      end else if (ena) begin
        q <= { q[2:0], q[3] };
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [2:0] vec,
  output [2:0] outv,
  output o2,
  output o1,
  output o0
);

  assign outv = vec;  // Directly output the vector
  assign o2 = vec[2]; // Select bit 2 (MSB)
  assign o1 = vec[1]; // Select bit 1
  assign o0 = vec[0]; // Select bit 0 (LSB)

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output out,
  output out_n
);

  wire t1, t2;

  assign t1 = a & b;         // First AND operation
  assign t2 = c & d;         // Second AND operation
  assign out = t1 | t2;      // OR of the two AND results
  assign out_n = ~(t1 | t2); // NOR of the two AND results

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [7:0] in,
  output reg [2:0] pos
);

always @(*) begin
  pos = 3'b000; // Default assignment
  for (integer i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
    if (in[i]) begin
      pos = i[2:0];
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input in,
  input [1:0] state,
  output reg [1:0] next_state,
  output out
);

  // Determine if the current state is a valid start state
  wire is_valid_start = (state == 2'b00) || (state == 2'b01) || (state == 2'b10);

  // Combinational logic for next state and output
  always @(*) begin
    next_state = state; // Default: remain in current state
    out = 1'b0;

    if (in) begin
      case (state)
        2'b00: next_state = 2'b01; // Start state 0 → 1
        2'b01: next_state = 2'b10; // Start state 1 → 2
        2'b10: next_state = 2'b00; // Start state 2 → 0
        default: next_state = 2'b00; // Invalid state → start state
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input  [3:0] in,
  output [3:0] out_both,
  output [3:0] out_any,
  output [3:0] out_different
);

  assign out_both = in & in;  // Bitwise AND of each bit with itself (result: 0 except LSB)
  assign out_any = in | in;  // Bitwise OR of each bit with itself (result: all 1s)
  assign out_different = in ^ in; // Bitwise XOR of each bit with itself (result: 0 except LSB)

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

  reg temp1, temp2;

  always @(*) begin
    temp1 = a ^ b;   // XOR a and b
    temp2 = c ^ d;   // XOR c and d
    out = temp1 ^ temp2; // XOR the results
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input d,
  input done_counting,
  input ack,
  input [9:0] state, // 10-bit one-hot current state
  output B3_next,
  output S_next,
  output S1_next,
  output Count_next,
  output Wait_next,
  output done,
  output counting,
  output shift_ena
);

  // State decoding (one-hot encoding)
  wire [9:0] state_one_hot = state;
  wire next_state = (state_one_hot[0] | state_one_hot[1] | state_one_hot[2] | 
                   state_one_hot[3] | state_one_hot[4] | state_one_hot[5] | 
                   state_one_hot[6] | state_one_hot[7] | state_one_hot[8] | 
                   state_one_hot[9]);

  // Output assignments
  assign B3_next = state[0]; // Assuming B3_next is active in state 0
  assign S_next = (state[1] & ack) | state[2]; // Example combination
  assign S1_next = state[3] & d; // Example combination
  assign Count_next = (state[4] & done_counting) | state[5]; // Example combination
  assign Wait_next = state[6] | (state[7] & ack); // Example combination
  assign done = state[8]; // Done in state 8
  assign counting = state[9]; // Counting in state 9
  assign shift_ena = state[0] | state[1]; // Example combination

endmodule
